name: A Spell at Sword’s Length
jem_summary: Land three positive melee hits on living non-player targets with a supported magical staff or blade.

pages.title: A Spell at Sword’s Length
pages.text: Land three positive melee hits on living non-player targets with a supported magical staff or blade.

pages.title: A Spell at Sword’s Length
pages.text: Try the melee side of magical equipment you already earned.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use the held staff or blade’s actual combat controls. These are ordinary direct melee hits; casting, skill activation and killing a boss are not claimed by this task.
